items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: I even recorded with Lester, made some beautiful recordings with him.

ctx.x: It's sort of like when -- now, who were some of the guys that you recall being on the scene in Los Angeles. You said like Benny Carter was there.
Yeah. Oh, gee. Now I really have to put my thinking cap on. Well, I met Lester Young out there for the first time.
